entries.title: July 2026 Pipeline and Backend Normalization Update
entries.summary: Updated the Phenobase loading pipeline and production backend index to use the current field definitions and normalized display values. This release does not add new data sources; it standardizes how existing records are loaded, exported, and rendered from the backend.
methodology: Applied targeted Elasticsearch backfills against the production Phenobase index to normalize backend values without introducing new source datasets.
Updated the loader, CSV export, and backfill helpers so future loads produce the same normalized field names and values used in the data field definitions.
Validated backend aggregate counts after the updates and kept source-specific loader transforms in sync with the updated field conventions.
Ran the phenobase_data unit test suite after the pipeline changes to confirm field renaming, export, source URL, NPN/NEON verbatim trait, and Zenodo package behavior.
changes: Normalized collectionMethod values in the backend to human observation, herbarium specimen image, and live plant image.
Normalized annotationMethod values in the backend to human and machine, replacing the legacy in_situ value.
Standardized NPN and NEON verbatimTrait values to use Phrase=0 or Phrase=1 instead of the previous parenthesized status format.
Updated iNaturalist flower handling so flower machine annotations map to the PPO open flower present trait and render verbatimTrait as open flowers.
Expanded field rename and export support for version 2 fields, including standardizedFamily, collectionMethod, annotationMethod, sourceRecordUrl, recordedBy, and accuracyFamily.
Improved standardizedFamily derivation and backfill behavior using GBIF family resolution with source-family fallbacks where authoritative lookup is unavailable.
Added or updated backend helpers to derive sourceRecordUrl values for NPN/NEON records and to preserve source links consistently in downloads.
Updated Zenodo package generation to use download-visible fields from the current column definitions and to support sampled per-datasource review packages.
notes: This entry documents pipeline and backend database normalization work rather than a new source harvest.
The production index was updated in place so existing records render with the current field-definition vocabulary.
Open data-model questions remain for taxonRank on iNaturalist and Herbarium records, source-derived organismID/locationID for iNaturalist, and final Herbarium flower trait/verbatimTrait wording.

entries.title: May 2026 Multi-source Harvest and Reload
entries.summary: Harvested and loaded refreshed human-observation and herbarium-derived sources on May 18, 2026, with datasource-specific PPO mappings and loader transforms.
methodology: Harvested source data and loaded the refreshed datasets into the Phenobase index on May 18, 2026.
Used the current ontology-derived traits.csv as the canonical source for trait_urn-to-trait resolution.
Validated datasource-specific mappings and transform files before loading through the Phenobase loader.
Added taxon-search support in the loader so records can carry a backend-friendly search field for family, genus, and scientific-name lookup.
changes: USA-NPN / NEON: converted the NPN fetch-and-transform workflow from Node to Python, refreshed mappings, and updated the phenophase fetcher to emit both present and absent status mappings where available.

PhenoObs: added the PhenoObs preparation workflow and mapping table, normalizing botanic-garden observations into loader-ready in-situ records with present/absent PPO trait mappings for vegetative growth, young leaves, flowers, ripe fruits, and senescence.
Budburst: added Budburst harvesting support, authentication-aware API fetching, plant-group/phenophase PPO mappings, and loader-ready output for leaf, flower, pollen, and fruit phenophases.
SeasonWatch India: added DwC-A harvesting support from the GBIF-hosted archive, value normalization for none/few/many observations, and PPO mappings for leaves, flowers, and fruits.

Herbarium: added an ingest transform that normalizes datasource naming, null handling, coordinates, dates, coordinate uncertainty, annotation method, and flower/fruit trait labels for herbarium inference records.
notes: The existing iNaturalist PhenoVision machine-annotation release remains documented separately as the March 23, 2026 release.
The May 18 data work is reflected in the phenobase_data version2 branch commits and README reload synopsis.

entries.title: Loading most recent iNaturalist Data
entries.summary: Expanded the production dataset from approximately 40 million to 71 million records.
methodology: Loaded the latest machine annotated images from iNaturalist photos into the production search index.
Rebuilt the index used by the Phenobase interface queries.
Verified that datasource, decade, family, genus, and mapped-trait aggregations completed after the load.
changes: Increased the searchable record count available in the interface.
Updated the global stats overview to reflect the expanded dataset.
Confirmed that the public interface continued querying the production index after the refresh.
